description: This Java class provides utility methods for parametric search based on product features within the OFBiz framework. It includes functions to retrieve features by category, get all features, and process request parameters related to product features and categories.

classes.name: ParametricSearch
classes.description: Utility class for handling parametric product feature searches, including retrieval and processing of feature data and request parameters.

methods.name: makeCategoryFeatureLists
methods.description: Retrieves product features associated with a specific category, organized by feature type, with optional size limit.

methods.name: getAllFeaturesByType
methods.description: Retrieves all product features grouped by feature type, with optional size limit.

methods.name: makeFeatureIdByTypeMap
methods.description: Creates a map of product feature type IDs to feature IDs from request parameters.

methods.name: makeFeatureIdListFromPrefixed
methods.description: Extracts a list of feature IDs from request parameters with prefix 'SEARCH_FEAT'.

methods.name: makeFeatureIdByTypeString
methods.description: Converts a map of feature type IDs to feature IDs into a URL query string.

methods.name: makeProductFeatureCategoryIdListFromPrefixed
methods.description: Extracts a list of product feature category IDs from request parameters with prefix 'SEARCH_PROD_FEAT_CAT'.
